content: We train the standard LexVec (LV), LexVec using n-grams (LV-N), and LexVec using unsupervised morphemes (LV-M) using the same hyper-parameters as BIBREF7 ( $\textnormal {window} = 2$ , $\textnormal {initial learning rate} = .025$ , $\textnormal {subsampling} = 10^{-5}$ , $\textnormal {negative samples} = 5$ , $\textnormal {context distribution smoothing} = .75$ , $\textnormal {positional contexts} = \textnormal {True}$ ).
